No abliterated checkpoint (grep abliterat|uncensor = 0 matches).

N-GLARE (ACL 2026 Long 1334) already illustrates JSS on 'RL-aligned, base, and safety-removed versions of Qwen3-4B'; Figure 7 DOES print layer-group Pearson/Spearman couplings of JSS with unsafe rate and refusal rate across DPO steps; still no code and no cross-model tau. 'N-GLARE has no correlations' is FALSE and may not be said. Its Refusal Rate is keyword refusal on HARMFUL prompts, so it is NOT over-refusal.
